cues: Water rises through the narrow vessels of a tree.
And farmers in the Terai plough their fields after rain to break the fine capillaries in the soil, so the water is not drawn up to the surface and lost.
text: Capillarity is all around you. Oil climbs a lamp wick. Water rises through the narrow vessels of a tree. Ink soaks into blotting paper. And farmers in the Terai plough their fields after rain to break the fine capillaries in the soil, so the water is not drawn up to the surface and lost.
